blocks.content: Course: React Hooks: Level Up Your First Web App
Here are some important features you can add to your project:

rows:
useFetch() handles the basics, but production apps need caching, background refresh, and stale data management.

Libraries like TanStack Query (React Query) solve these problems and replace manual fetch hooks entirely.
React Router adds URL-based navigation. Each route renders a component — hooks work exactly the same inside them.

Prop drilling means passing props through multiple layers of components just to reach a deeply nested child.

The Context API (useContext() + createContext()) solves this by letting you share values across the component tree without threading props through every level.
